entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alfred Georg Heinrich Maria Freiherr von Waldstätten was an Austro-Hungarian Army officer holding the rank of Generalmajor who served during World War I. He held senior positions on the Armeeoberkommando and possessed significant influence over the Chief of General Staff, Arthur Arz von Straußenburg, and Emperor Karl.

entities.summary: Alfred Georg Heinrich Maria Freiherr von Waldstätten was an Austro-Hungarian Army officer holding the rank of Generalmajor who served during World War I. He held senior positions on the Armeeoberkommando and possessed significant influence over the Chief of General Staff, Arthur Arz von Straußenburg, and Emperor Karl.
